commit_note: code_commit is HEAD when the selection was computed; this file is committed in the next commit, before any reserved episode runs. `git log -- studies/program-v2/freeze.json` names the freeze commit.

memory_rules.agent_solution: max(tensor walk, every tensor/array/buffer payload the solution kept alive anywhere in the process, live CUDA bytes, peak CUDA bytes during the episodes), measured after compress and again after inference; the untouched baseline is sized the same way with one forward pass. Same rule and evaluator commit as program-v1's re-scored winners (49507417b3252530e7f67ccf7fa0fb665c26510a, merged in f2dba2e), so the two programs are comparable.

rule.selection_data: development phase only; no reserved episode existed when this record was written
steps: The uncompressed reference B16 is the paired control. Its reserved result from program-v1 is reused: same suite, same 50 reserved states per task, same seeds (1000, final offset 10000).

A node is selected when it has a complete development record, passes the gate (>= 77/100) and has no memory-rule violation. Both qualifying nodes are selected; neither dominates the other (83/100 at 79.1 % removed versus 82/100 at 79.6 % removed).
iter_000-b2-a2 (83.4 % removed) is not selected: its development run hit the 1800 s evaluator limit at 59/100 episodes, so it has no gate result. It is reported as a timeout, not as a candidate.
No candidate is added by taste. Cells outside this record are not selected however well they scored in development.
rule.statistics: Wilson 95 % per arm; task-stratified paired bootstrap (10000 resamples, seed 42) against B16 on identical task/state/seed keys. Development and reserved stay separate.
